# FDG3007

> DO NOT assume that all programming languages are case sensitive. They are not. Names cannot differ by case alone.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.1.4 Case Sensitivity.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1708
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

CA1708 is limited to the public API because chapter 3 governs public names; without the limit it reports private fields that differ by case from their public properties (docs/noise-samples.md).

## Options

```ini
dotnet_code_quality.CA1708.api_surface = public
```
